background_note: Opaque files are lossless with the exact page colour. Files with mode RGBA are lossy colour with a lossless alpha plane in which every pixel equal to the page colour is transparent, so the page colour shows through exactly.

figures.name: class_example_crops
figures.alt: Two three-by-three grids of single-cell fluorescence crops on black, labelled SAG1 (left) and GRA14 (right). Each crop shows a HeLa cell with a blue nucleus, green GFP-TSG101 and red Toxoplasma vacuoles; in most SAG1 crops the vacuoles look yellow where green overlaps red, in the GRA14 crops they stay red.
figures.caption: The 9 held-out cells per class that spaCR's CNN classified correctly with the highest confidence, from 405 test cells (306 SAG1-well, 99 GRA14-well) in 4 wells never used for training (A01, C02, F01, H01); test accuracy 0.909, ROC AUC 0.958.
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.); 224 px single-cell PNG crops read from plate1-data.tar of spacr-example-screen (blue nuclei, green GFP-TSG101, red Toxoplasma); classes are the screen's control wells: column 1 (A01-H01, enriched for guides against SAG1, TGGT1_233460, the negative control) versus column 2 (A02-H02, enriched for guides against GRA14, TGGT1_239740, the positive control whose loss removes TSG101 recruitment to the vacuole). Dataset by spacr.io.generate_training_dataset (split by well), MobileNetV3-small by spacr.deep_spacr.train_test_model; tiles by spacr.plot.plot_image_grid (1-99.5 percentile stretch per channel).

figures.name: saliency_maps
figures.alt: Four rows of five single-cell crops: SAG1 crops, the same cells as dim grey images with a magma heat overlay of input-gradient saliency drawn only inside the cell, then GRA14 crops and their saliency overlays. The heat is brightest along the cell outline, with smaller hot spots inside the cells.
figures.caption: Input-gradient saliency (SmoothGrad, 32 samples) of the CNN for the 5 most confident correct held-out cells per class, shown inside the cell only; in 10 of 10 cells the share of saliency inside the cell (39-93%) is below the share of the crop the cell covers (50-95%), and inside the cell it peaks at the cell outline.
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.); 224 px single-cell PNG crops read from plate1-data.tar of spacr-example-screen (blue nuclei, green GFP-TSG101, red Toxoplasma); classes are the screen's control wells: column 1 (A01-H01, enriched for guides against SAG1, TGGT1_233460, the negative control) versus column 2 (A02-H02, enriched for guides against GRA14, TGGT1_239740, the positive control whose loss removes TSG101 recruitment to the vacuole). Saliency by spacr.attribution.AttributionMapGenerator(method='saliency', smoothgrad_samples=32, smoothgrad_sigma=0.15) (captum Saliency: absolute gradient of the predicted-class logit with respect to the input), on the MobileNetV3-small checkpoint of spacr.deep_spacr.train_test_model. Display: Gaussian blur sigma 2 px, scaled to the 40th-99.5th percentile of interior pixels.

figures.name: shap_beeswarm
figures.alt: SHAP beeswarm: twelve feature names on the left, one row of coloured dots per feature along a horizontal SHAP value axis from about -1.1 to 1.4. The top rows, cell_channel_1_shannon_entropy and cell_channel_1_channel_2_M2_correlation_85, spread widest in both directions; lower rows cluster near zero.
figures.caption: SHAP values of spaCR's XGBoost model for 256 held-out cells from 3 wells (C02, D02, H01), top 12 of 76 features by mean |SHAP|; each dot is a cell coloured by its feature value (dark low, yellow high), and positive values push toward the GRA14 class (well-grouped 5-fold accuracy 0.853, ROC AUC 0.922 on 1,277 cells).
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.); per-cell measurements from measurements.db of spacr-example-hit (the plate-1 cut of spacr-example-screen, fields 1-4); classes are the screen's control wells: column 1 (A01-H01, enriched for guides against SAG1, TGGT1_233460, the negative control) versus column 2 (A02-H02, enriched for guides against GRA14, TGGT1_239740, the positive control whose loss removes TSG101 recruitment to the vacuole). Model from spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores (xgboost, channel_of_interest 1); SHAP values from spacr.ml._shap_values; beeswarm drawn by spaCR's pyqtgraph FastPlot.add_beeswarm and FastPlot.export_styled.

figures.name: shap_waterfall_cell
figures.alt: SHAP waterfall for one cell: ten horizontal arrows, red pushing right and blue pushing left, from the expected value 0.178 at the bottom to f(x) = 1.545 at the top; cell_channel_1_shannon_entropy adds the largest positive contribution.
figures.caption: Per-cell SHAP explanation of one held-out GRA14-well cell (plate 1, well C02, field 1, object 35): the model's base value of 0.178 log-odds plus the feature contributions gives 1.545, a GRA14 probability of 0.82.
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.); per-cell measurements from measurements.db of spacr-example-hit (the plate-1 cut of spacr-example-screen, fields 1-4); classes are the screen's control wells: column 1 (A01-H01, enriched for guides against SAG1, TGGT1_233460, the negative control) versus column 2 (A02-H02, enriched for guides against GRA14, TGGT1_239740, the positive control whose loss removes TSG101 recruitment to the vacuole). SHAP values from spacr.ml._shap_values; drawn by shap.plots.waterfall (spaCR has no per-cell SHAP plot), recoloured for the page and saved with spacr.plot.save_figure.

figures.name: xgb_feature_importance
figures.alt: Horizontal grey bar chart of the 15 most important measurement features, longest bar at the top for cell_channel_1_channel_2_M2_correlation_85 (about 0.20), then cell_channel_1_shannon_entropy (about 0.13).
figures.caption: Top 15 of 76 features by XGBoost importance for the model trained on 1,021 control cells from 13 wells; cell_channel_1_channel_2_M2_correlation_85 ranks first (0.196), then cell_channel_1_shannon_entropy (0.133).
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.); per-cell measurements from measurements.db of spacr-example-hit (the plate-1 cut of spacr-example-screen, fields 1-4); classes are the screen's control wells: column 1 (A01-H01, enriched for guides against SAG1, TGGT1_233460, the negative control) versus column 2 (A02-H02, enriched for guides against GRA14, TGGT1_239740, the positive control whose loss removes TSG101 recruitment to the vacuole). Importances are the fitted XGBClassifier's feature_importances_ (gain) written by spacr.ml.generate_ml_scores; bars by spacr.plot.plot_feature_importance.

figures.name: umap
figures.alt: UMAP scatter of 5,000 cells forming 6 outlined, numbered clusters on the left; on the right one row per cluster with its number, its cell count and four example single-cell crops framed in the cluster colour.
figures.caption: UMAP of 6 measurements of 5,000 randomly sampled cells from screen plate 1 (60,816 cells), 6 DBSCAN clusters that differ mainly in nuclei and parasite objects per cell (1: 2,529 cells, median 1 nucleus and 1 parasite object; 2: 146 cells, median 1 nucleus and 1 parasite object; 3: 1,131 cells, median 1 nucleus and 2 parasite objects; 4: 468 cells, median 2 nuclei and 1 parasite object; 5: 502 cells, median 2 nuclei and 3 parasite objects; 6: 223 cells, median 3 nuclei and 3 parasite objects); crops are cells near each cluster centre.
figures.provenance: spaCR GFP-TSG101 recruitment screen, plate 1 (HF datasets einarolafsson/spacr-example-screen and einarolafsson/spacr-example-hit, CC BY 4.0; Olafsson EB et al.): plate1-measurements.tar (measurements.db) and plate1-data.tar crops. Measurements by spacr.io._read_and_merge_data (no nucleus/pathogen limits); features nucleus_prcfo_count, pathogen_prcfo_count, cell_area, pathogen_area (mean per cell), pathogen_channel_2_mean_intensity, cell_channel_2_mean_intensity, log1p then z-scored; embedding and clusters by spacr.utils.reduction_and_clustering (UMAP n_neighbors 30, min_dist 0.1, seed 0; DBSCAN eps 0.6, min_samples 50, chosen from a sweep as closest to 5 clusters; 0.02% unassigned; silhouette 0.48). Gallery: of the 60 cells nearest each cluster's median position, the 30 with the brightest parasite channel, shuffled (seed 0), one per field, 8 fetched, the 4 with the fewest near-black central pixels shown.
